note: Only tax-litigation data could be verified. Indian Kanoon returns 8 documents mentioning the company, all of them CESTAT/CEGAT central excise and service tax matters (2006-2015); the company appears as appellant/taxpayer and its 2006 ruling is cited favourably in later cases. These are tax disputes, not criminal or sanctions matters, and per project rules are not rejection grounds. No sanctions listing was confirmed: the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is a JavaScript form and returned no queryable result set via HTTP fetch, so OFAC SDN / Non-SDN status is UNVERIFIED, not cleared; UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List screens could not be run because the web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) throughout the session. No credit rating found in public sources (null - not public / not verified). No negative news, regulator action or evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found or confirmed; rf_supply is null because no customs, bill-of-lading or trade-data source could be queried, NOT because absence was established. Company registry pages (Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck) returned HTTP 403 and the claimed website domain did not resolve, so no corporate filings, GST turnover or ownership data were obtained. Recommend re-running sanctions screening (OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS) and trade-data checks when search access is restored.
